About Inside Out

Inside Out is about helping people working in digital roles build confidence, skill and impact in their work.

Chris Taylor

Chris is currently a Design Principal at the Home Office where he’s worked for 9 years in various roles, including Head of User-Centred Design and Head of Interaction Design.

He has 15+ years’ experience in user-centred design and strategic leadership for organisations in the public and private sector working both as part of in-house teams and in an agency. He is passionate about fostering design communities, establishing standards and best practices, and advocating for user-centred design at scale.

When not working, he likes to watch movies, run (very slowly) and make art.

Gemma Barnes

Gemma has been a service design practitioner for a decade after starting her career in user experience design almost 20 years ago.

She has worked extensively in the public and private sector, helping organisations to become service-led and user-focused.

Notable work includes driving forward user-centred design and service thinking within the Home Office and leading the design of a ground-breaking digital education, communication and rehabilitation service for people in prison while at the Ministry of Justice.

She also mentors those who are breaking into the profession. Gemma is passionate about making services visible, accessible and effective. Outside of work Gemma is a keen photographer, enjoying spending time in the great outdoors.
